description: This file defines the abstract base class 'ExportableModule' which extends torch.nn.Module, providing an interface for modules that can be exported to ONNX format. It includes abstract methods and default implementations for providing example arguments, dynamic input shapes, input and output tensor names, and a method to perform the export.

classes.name: ExportableModule
classes.description: An abstract base class for modules that can be exported to ONNX. It requires subclasses to implement methods for providing example arguments for tracing, dynamic shape specifications, input and output tensor names, and provides a method to export the module to ONNX format.

methods.name: tuple[tuple[Any],dict[str,Any]|None] example_arguments(self)
methods.description: Abstract method that should return sample inputs and optional keyword arguments for the model's forward method, used for tracing and testing.

methods.name: Any dynamic_shapes(self)
methods.description: Returns specifications for dimensions of input tensors that are dynamic during ONNX export. Defaults to None indicating static shapes.

methods.name: Sequence[str]|None input_names(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of names for input tensors in the ONNX graph. Defaults to None for automatic naming.

methods.name: Sequence[str]|None output_names(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of names for output tensors in the ONNX graph. Defaults to None for automatic naming.

methods.name: torch.onnx.ONNXProgram to_onnx(self, **kwargs: Any)
methods.description: Exports the module to ONNX format by wrapping torch.onnx.export, using example arguments and other metadata provided by the class.

ctags.name: example_arguments
ctags.pattern: /^    def example_arguments(self) -> tuple[tuple[Any], dict[str, Any] | None]:$/
